visible structure, endpoint, assay, species, formulation, exposure, and
condition. Infer direction from the record cards first, then judge transfer from
all visible context. Do not invent a numeric similarity judgment or assume that
a higher transfer_likelihood must outweigh a concrete experimental mismatch.

Use general medicinal-chemistry knowledge to interpret structures, but ground
every compound-specific empirical claim in the supplied query prior or cited
record cards. Repeated records and multiple cards from one context are not
independent evidence. Return exactly one valid JSON object and do not reveal
hidden chain-of-thought.

claims.claim: The closest structural context, beclomethasone 17-monopropionate (17-BMP), has measured absolute oral bioavailability of 41% (90% CI 31–54%) after oral administration of BDP in healthy subjects, with systemic availability estimates of 21–41%, all at or above the 20% threshold.
Related halogenated steroid contexts (chlormadinone acetate ~100%, cyproterone acetate 88%) show high oral bioavailability, supporting high oral absorption for this steroid class.

evidence_gaps: No direct absolute oral bioavailability measurement for beclomethasone itself; the closest evidence is for its 17-propionate ester (17-BMP) after oral BDP.
The 17-propionate ester may alter absorption, stability, or first-pass metabolism relative to the free 17-hydroxy query.
No query-specific data on first-pass metabolism, efflux transport, or formulation effects.
The 21% systemic availability estimate (C09) is close to the 20% threshold, adding uncertainty about the margin.
